terms.heroTitle: Patient Charter of Rights & Clinical Terms of Service
terms.heroDesc: This agreement consists of 7 articles governing the legal and clinical relationship between patients, healthcare providers, and Angabin Teb.
terms.acceptanceNote: Accessing the platform, booking appointments, or subscribing to tele-nutrition plans constitutes full acceptance and compliance with all articles of this agreement.

articles.title: Article 1: Clinical Terms & Definitions
articles.body: 'Angabin Teb' refers to the digital health platform providing clinical scheduling and electronic health services. 'Patient/Client' is any individual seeking medical care. 'Physician/Specialist' is a licensed practitioner registered with the Medical Council. 'Deposit' is the authorized reservation fee deducted from the final consultation fee.

articles.title: Article 2: General Membership & Patient Identity Verification
articles.body: Registration requires a valid mobile phone number belonging to the patient or legal guardian. Providing a valid National ID is mandatory for issuing electronic prescriptions under public health insurances; legal liability for any inaccurate information rests entirely with the user.

articles.title: Article 3: Appointment Scheduling, Deposit, & Cancellation Regulations
articles.body: All confirmed reservations require a nominal deposit (2,500 Tomans). The remainder is settled at the clinic per official Ministry of Health tariffs. In case of cancellation at least 2 hours prior to the slot, 100% of the deposit is refunded to the Health Wallet. Unannounced no-shows forfeit the reservation.

articles.title: Article 4: Tele-Nutrition Regimens & Clinical Protocols
articles.body: Diet plans formulated on the platform are based strictly on self-reported biometrics and patient lab records. Patients must declare all pre-existing chronic conditions, food allergies, pregnancy, or ongoing pharmacotherapy. Medication alterations must solely be directed by the attending prescribing physician.

articles.title: Article 5: Privacy & Electronic Health Record (EHR) Confidentiality
articles.body: All medical records, lab findings, clinical imagery, and communications are protected with industry-standard encryption, accessible exclusively to accredited treating practitioners. Angabin Teb strictly guarantees that patient data is never disclosed to third parties or utilized for advertising.

articles.title: Article 6: Emergency Situations Disclaimer (Call 115)
articles.body: Angabin Teb and its booking portal do not substitute pre-hospital emergency medical services (115). In life-threatening emergencies, severe chest pain, loss of consciousness, acute respiratory distress, or severe hemorrhage, call 115 or visit an emergency room immediately.

articles.title: Article 7: Intellectual Property Rights & Patient Review Guidelines
articles.body: All articles, clinical pamphlets, the Iranian Food Database structure, computational algorithms, and registered trademarks belong to Angabin Teb. Patient reviews are verified against clinical ethics standards and respectful discourse before publication.

siteHelp.heroTitle: Comprehensive Guide to Angabin Teb Platform Services
siteHelp.heroDesc: Step-by-step walkthroughs for online appointment booking, electronic health records, tele-nutrition diets, and health wallet management.

guides.title: 1. Online Doctor & Clinic Appointment Booking Guide
steps: From the main menu or homepage, navigate to the Clinical Specialties booking section.
Search for the desired medical specialty (Cardiology, Dermatology, Internal Medicine) or doctor name.
On the doctor's profile, select your preferred available slot from morning or afternoon clinics.
Provide patient registration details and choose your deposit payment method (Health Wallet or Online Gateway).
Upon confirmation, an SMS containing your booking tracking code and clinic address will be instantly dispatched.

guides.title: 2. Deposit Payment & Clinic Settlement Guide
steps: To finalize the reservation and prevent no-shows, a nominal deposit (2,500 Tomans) is processed online.
The remaining consultation fee per official medical council tariffs is settled directly at the clinic reception.
Cancellations made at least 2 hours prior to the appointment result in a 100% deposit refund to your Health Wallet.

guides.title: 3. Electronic Health Record (EHR) Setup Guide
steps: From your account dashboard, open the Health Record section (/registry).
Complete the 8-step clinical onboarding: personal vitals, chronic illnesses, medications, dietary habits, and lab tests.
Upload scans of your latest blood work, ultrasound, or imaging in step 7.
Once submitted, your unique EHR ID is generated, granting authorized clinicians instant access to your clinical timeline.

guides.title: 4. Tele-Nutrition & Personalized Diet Plans Guide
steps: Enter Tele-Nutrition and choose your clinical objective across 18 specialized categories (Fatty Liver, Diabetes, Weight Loss).
Record biometric measurements: waist circumference, hip circumference, height, and current weight.
Select your clinical care tier (Bronze, Silver, Gold, or VIP).
An accredited university clinical nutritionist will curate your personalized regimen within 24 hours under 'My Diet'.

guides.title: 5. Calorie Tracker & Traditional Portion Units Guide
steps: In the Daily Food Diary, select the meal type (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, or Snack).
Instead of requiring a gram scale, log entries using familiar traditional measures like palm-sized bread, spoonfuls of rice, or glasses.
The system dynamically computes calories, protein, carbs, and fiber against your daily Mifflin-St Jeor metabolic target.

guides.title: 6. Home Clinical & Nursing Care Request Guide
steps: From the booking menu, select Home Healthcare Services.
Choose the required clinical procedure (physician home visit, IV therapy, wound dressing, blood draw, or infant phototherapy).
Enter the exact patient address and contact number.
A licensed nursing professional will be dispatched to your location within 45 to 120 minutes.

guides.title: 7. Health Wallet Top-Up & Refund Guide
steps: In your user dashboard, navigate to Health Wallet.
Choose the top-up amount and add funds securely through the official banking gateway.
With wallet balance, appointment slots are booked instantly in a single click without repetitive card details.
Canceled qualified appointments are automatically refunded back to your wallet balance with zero delay.
